name: The Prison's Bindings
label: Quest
description: The Prison's Bindings: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You must retrieve bindings for the prison of the Doomguard from lesser demons.
The blood of the Wildspawn satyr that occupy Dire Maul should do nicely. The coagulated blood will bond the Hederine shards and power the crystal prison.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Only the blood of Wildspawn satyr will suffice.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, a most excellent recovery. The blood will suppress the Doomguard's magical defenses.
